interface.signature: def findString(N: int, K: int) -> str:

preconditions.description: N must be an integer between 1 and 4 inclusive.
K must be an integer strictly between 1 and 10.
K^N must be strictly between 1 and 4096.

postconditions.expression: all(substring in S for substring in all_possible_substrings(N, K))
postconditions.description: The returned string S must contain all possible substrings of length N with characters from 0 to K-1 as substrings.
The length of S must be the minimum possible length that satisfies Q1.
